tool_schemas.name: sites_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists sites visible to the caller, optionally filtered by workspace_id and status, and returns results sorted as requested; responses are paged with limit and an opaque cursor that you pass back to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range or any filter/sort value is invalid, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot access the requested workspace/sites. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

limit.description: Maximum number of sites to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: sites_get
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single site by site_id and returns its workspace association, status, and publish-related metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if site_id does not match the required format, and NOT_FOUND if no site with that id exists or it is not visible to the caller. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to view the site.

tool_schemas.name: sites_publish
tool_schemas.description: Publishes a site to the specified publish_mode (live or staging), optionally limited to the provided domains, and returns a publish event record for the request (including who requested it when provided). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid site_id, publish_mode, or domains list, and NOT_FOUND if the site does not exist or is not accessible. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot publish the site, CONFLICT if the site cannot be published in its current state (for example, disabled/archived or another publish is in progress), and RATE_LIMITED when publish quotas are exceeded.

domains.description: Domains to publish to (e.g., custom domains); if omitted, publish to the site's configured domains.

requested_by.description: Identifier (user/email) for who requested the publish.

tool_schemas.name: pages_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists pages for a site, optionally filtered by page_type, status, and collection_id, and returns a paged result set using limit and cursor with sorting by the requested field and order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if site_id is malformed, limit is out of range, or filters/sort values are invalid (including providing a collection_id that does not match the required format). Raises NOT_FOUND if the site does not exist or is not accessible, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to list pages for the site.

site_id.description: Site id to list pages for.

collection_id.description: Filter pages by associated CMS collection (for collection templates).

limit.description: Maximum number of pages to return.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: pages_get_metadata
tool_schemas.description: Returns the metadata for a page (for example name, slug/path, type, status, and SEO/Open Graph settings where applicable). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page_id is malformed, and NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist or is not accessible. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller does not have permission to view the page.

page_id.description: Page id to fetch metadata for.

tool_schemas.name: pages_update_page_settings
tool_schemas.description: Updates editable page settings for the specified page (such as name, slug, SEO fields, Open Graph, canonical URL, and password protection) and returns the updated page metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page_id is invalid or any provided field value fails validation, and NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist or is not accessible. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot edit the page, and CONFLICT if the update is not allowed for the page’s current state (for example, deleted pages).

is_password_protected.description: Whether the page is password protected.

tool_schemas.name: pages_get_content
tool_schemas.description: Fetches the page content for the given page_id and returns either the draft or live variant when variant is provided (defaulting to the server’s default when omitted). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page_id or variant is invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist or is not accessible. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot view the requested content variant.

page_id.description: Page id to fetch content for.

tool_schemas.name: pages_update_static_content
tool_schemas.description: Replaces the full static page content object for the specified variant (draft or live) and returns the updated content for that variant. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if page_id/variant are invalid or content is missing/invalid, and NOT_FOUND if the page does not exist, is not accessible, or is not a static page. Raises FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot edit content, and CONFLICT if updating the requested variant is not allowed in the page’s current state (for example, deleted pages).

page_id.description: Static page id to update content for.

content.description: The full page content object to set for the selected variant.

tool_schemas.name: collections_list
tool_schemas.description: Lists CMS collections visible to the caller, optionally filtered by site_id, status, and is_singleton, and returns results paged with limit and cursor and sorted by the requested field and order. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if limit is out of range or any filter/sort value is invalid (including malformed site_id), and NOT_FOUND if a specified site_id does not exist or is not accessible. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks permission to view collections for the requested scope.

site_id.description: Filter collections to a specific Webflow site id.

is_singleton.description: Filter collections by whether they are singletons.

limit.description: Maximum number of collections to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination to the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: collections_get
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a CMS collection by collection_id and returns its schema and metadata. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if collection_id is malformed, and NOT_FOUND if the collection does not exist or is not accessible. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to view the collection.

collection_id.description: Webflow CMS collection id to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: collections_items_create_item_live
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new CMS item directly in the live variant of the specified collection and returns the created item, including its live_fields and live_status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if collection_id is not a valid Webflow collection id, if required fields (name, slug, live_fields) are missing, if live_status is not one of the allowed values, or if live_fields does not conform to the collection schema; raises NOT_FOUND if the collection does not exist or is not accessible. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you don’t have permission to manage CMS items for the site that owns the collection, and raises CONFLICT if the slug is already in use within the collection or the collection is in a state that prevents item creation.

collection_id.description: Webflow CMS collection id to create the item in.

live_fields.description: Live field values for the item (must conform to the collection's fields schema).

live_status.description: Initial live status for the item.

body.description: Fields used to create a live CMS item.

tool_schemas.name: collections_items_update_items_live
tool_schemas.description: Batch-updates one or more existing live CMS items in the specified collection and returns the updated items in the same order as the request. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if collection_id/item_id formats are invalid, the items array is empty, a provided status is invalid, or any provided live_fields values fail schema validation; raises NOT_FOUND if the collection or any referenced item does not exist or does not belong to the collection. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you lack permission to edit live CMS items, and raises CONFLICT if a requested update cannot be applied (for example, a slug collision within the collection).

collection_id.description: Webflow CMS collection id that owns the items.

items.description: List of live item updates to apply.

item_id.description: Webflow CMS item id to update.

slug.description: Updated URL-friendly slug for the item.

live_fields.description: Live field values to set/replace (must conform to the collection's fields schema).

live_status.description: Updated live status for the item.

tool_schemas.name: collections_items_list_items
tool_schemas.description: Lists CMS items for the specified collection and returns a paged result set filtered by stage (draft or live), status, is_archived, and search, sorted by the requested field and order. Pagination is cursor-based: we return up to limit items and include a next cursor when more results are available; pass that cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if collection_id is invalid, limit is out of range, stage/status/sort/order are not allowed or inconsistent for the selected stage, and raises NOT_FOUND if the collection does not exist or is not accessible; raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you don’t have permission to view the collection’s items.

collection_id.description: Webflow CMS collection id to list items from.

stage.description: Which variant to list/filter against (draft_fields/draft_status vs live_fields/live_status).

status.description: Filter by status for the chosen stage (draft: draft|pending_publish|archived; live: unpublished|published|archived).

search.description: Search term applied to item name and slug.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor for pagination to the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: collections_items_create_item
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new CMS item in the draft variant of the specified collection and returns the created item, including its draft_fields and draft_status. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if collection_id is invalid, required fields (name, slug, draft_fields) are missing, draft_status is not one of the allowed values, or draft_fields does not conform to the collection schema; raises NOT_FOUND if the collection does not exist or is not accessible. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you don’t have permission to manage CMS items for the site that owns the collection, and raises CONFLICT if the slug is already in use within the collection or the collection is in a state that prevents item creation.

collection_id.description: Webflow CMS collection id to create the item in.

draft_fields.description: Draft field values for the item (must conform to the collection's fields schema).

draft_status.description: Initial draft status for the item.

is_draft.description: Whether the item is marked as draft.

body.description: Fields used to create a draft CMS item.

tool_schemas.name: collections_items_update_items
tool_schemas.description: Batch-updates one or more existing draft CMS items in the specified collection and returns the updated items in the same order as the request. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if collection_id/item_id formats are invalid, the items array is empty, a provided draft_status is invalid, is_draft/is_archived are not booleans, or any provided draft_fields values fail schema validation; raises NOT_FOUND if the collection or any referenced item does not exist or does not belong to the collection. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you lack permission to edit draft CMS items, and raises CONFLICT if a requested update cannot be applied (for example, a slug collision within the collection).

collection_id.description: Webflow CMS collection id that owns the items.

items.description: List of draft item updates to apply.

item_id.description: Webflow CMS item id to update.

slug.description: Updated URL-friendly slug for the item.

draft_fields.description: Draft field values to set/replace (must conform to the collection's fields schema).

draft_status.description: Updated draft status for the item.

is_draft.description: Whether the item is marked as draft.

tool_schemas.name: collections_items_publish_items
tool_schemas.description: Publishes the specified CMS items from draft to the requested publish_mode (live or staging) and returns a publish result for the requested item_ids. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if collection_id is invalid, item_ids is empty, any item_id is invalid, or publish_mode is not one of the allowed values; raises NOT_FOUND if the collection or any referenced item does not exist or does not belong to the collection. Raises AUTHORIZATION_ERROR if you don’t have permission to publish CMS items, and raises CONFLICT if any item cannot be published due to an invalid state transition (for example, the item is archived or has draft content that is not eligible to publish).

collection_id.description: Webflow CMS collection id that owns the items to publish.

item_ids.description: List of CMS item ids to publish from draft to live.

publish_mode.description: Where to publish the items (live or staging).

requested_by.description: Identifier (user/email/id) of the requester initiating the publish.

tool_schemas.name: sites_update
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing site’s editable properties (name, short_name, timezone, domains) and/or transitions its status between active and disabled. Refuses attempts to set status to archived through this endpoint (use the product’s archival flow if available). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields (including malformed domain names/timezone), NOT_FOUND if the site does not exist or is not visible, and FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot update the site or perform the requested status transition.

short_name.description: Short site name used for display in lists.

timezone.description: IANA timezone identifier for the site (e.g., "America/Los_Angeles").

custom_domains.description: Custom domains configured for the site. Domain format is validated.

status.description: Set the site status. Only active <-> disabled transitions are allowed.

metadata.name: Webflow MCP Server
metadata.description: This backend stores Webflow workspaces/sites and their editable resources: pages (metadata + content), CMS collections, and CMS items with draft/live variants. The main workflows are: list/get sites and pages, update page settings or static content, manage CMS items in draft or live, publish selecte
